canonicalTree.$comment: `skills` is GENERATED by skills-sync (`npm run skills:export`), gitignored, and never committed (decided 2026-08-12). The distribution renderer must PRODUCE this directory, not drift-check a tracked one; there is no committed baseline to compare against and there deliberately is not going to be. The `agent-plugins` registration in server/skills-sync.yaml ships empty, because an entry there would make this repo's guess the default for every installation — see server/skills-sync.example.yaml for the enable path. `manifest` and `mcp` ARE committed and ARE drift-checkable.
